evidence_limits: Offline unit tests verify deterministic search mechanics only. No provider search, model visual review, or human A/B review has been run for these cases.

protocol.inputs: For each case, freeze a licensed or user-provided local image pool. Include exact reposts, same-family color variants, attractive but unsuitable works, and distinct usable alternatives. Record image provenance and actual file paths before running.
protocol.comparison: Compare a plain-agent baseline with the skill under the same task, image pool, and presentation budget.
mechanical_checks: Stable candidate identity and index mapping survive query completion permutations.
Exact reposts do not consume multiple selection slots; provenance is retained.
Download failures are replaced only within the retained pool, with shortfalls reported.
Shared gallery URLs do not automatically collapse different images.
The reported decoded-preview count and displayed-candidate count match their actual artifacts.
visual_rubric: Relevance and feasibility: candidates respect the brief and can support its important page types.
Decision-relevant difference: alternatives change permitted design choices instead of merely relabeling near duplicates.
Constraint-aware coverage: suitable distinct alternatives in the pool are not silently omitted, and irrelevant candidates are not added to satisfy a numerical quota.
Evidence honesty: unknown details and unavailable previews are identified rather than inferred from titles.
do_not_score: A fixed count of four directions or fourteen images.
Hue differences when color is constrained by the brief.
Adjacent-layout differences when repeated structure helps comparison.
Query count or source count as a substitute for visual differences.
protocol.blind_review: Randomize anonymous A/B outputs and keep the answer key separate. Record reviewer, reviewed_at, winner, rubric-based reason, and an attestation that judgment preceded revealing the key. Pending cases do not count as completed human evidence.

cases.prompt: 把游戏投资叙事做成视觉主导的分享 PPT，没有指定风格。请先给我真正不同且适合正文的灵感选择。
cases.fixture_requirements: A frozen pool containing repeated dark cinematic covers, reposted template images under different pin IDs, and several relevant but distinct layout systems.
assertions: Layout keywords target presentation layouts by page type; style-element keywords spread across the user's own words, rendering styles and languages; the two are kept in separate groups.
The gallery shows each keyword group's results in Pinterest order without the agent dropping images by taste; a reposted template appears once per gallery.
Directions are written only after the user picks, from the picked images, and claims about content-page support are tied to those images.
cases.human_notes: Judge the usefulness of differences and the relation to source content; no required direction count.

cases.prompt: 用像素风做一套培训 PPT，先帮我找参考。
cases.fixture_requirements: A frozen pool with slide layouts by page type, pictures of the named style (interface, icons, scenes, textures) and look-alike styles that are not it.
assertions: Every keyword carries the named style's own name: its ready-made decks, slides made in it by page type, and its own elements; brief.style_terms lists those names.
Generic business layouts (flow charts, comparison slides, pricing tables without the style's name) and look-alike styles are not searched unless the user asks, with their words in beyond_style.

The agent opens the original images, then offers two or three pairings, each composed into one board (layouts on the left, style elements on the right), without removing any image; the user takes one, mixes or picks their own.
cases.human_notes: Judge whether the layout groups are slides one can lay out from and the style groups stay in the named style; the combination is the user's choice.

cases.prompt: 为工业运营月报找 PPT 灵感，需要趋势、流程和三个工厂的同口径比较，风格尚未确定。
cases.fixture_requirements: A separate frozen pool from an unrelated domain: usable data layouts, diagrams, decorative posters, and near-duplicate corporate templates.
assertions: Keywords cover the data, process and comparison page types the content needs.
The agent does not drop posters or plain templates on the user's behalf; after the pick it says what each chosen image can and cannot carry.
The review may recommend repeated layouts for the factory comparison.
cases.human_notes: Check transfer beyond the original narrative example; compare comprehension and page-type usefulness, not spectacle.

cases.prompt: 品牌限定黑白和指定字体，请在这些条件内给机构简报找不同的版式方向。
cases.fixture_requirements: A frozen pool containing several monochrome hierarchy/grid treatments plus colorful, visually distinct but brand-incompatible examples.
assertions: Color and font constraints stay fixed in the keywords and in the direction written from the picks.
Images that conflict with the brand constraint are pointed out to the user, not silently dropped.
If the user's picks support only two directions, the result does not invent more.
cases.human_notes: Same colors are not evidence of poor diversity; assess meaningful differences within the constraint set.

cases.prompt: 严格使用我选好的这套模板，连续三页分别展示三个地区的相同指标，不需要再找新风格。
cases.fixture_requirements: A complete user-selected template with usable comparison layouts and explicit style specifications.
assertions: No additional inspiration search is required when the supplied reference is sufficient.
No incompatible direction is added to achieve a diversity quota.
Repeated layouts are allowed when they aid comparison; any variation has a content-driven reason.
cases.human_notes: This is a boundary case against overgeneralizing exploration and adjacent-layout rules.
